text:
Carla: Quick follow-up from the pm for RW cache eviction outage — want to lock owners, timelines, and handoff plan so this doesn't slip. Short thread to assign.
Carla: TL;DR: recurring cache churn seen over past 3 incidents, root cause is aggressive eviction under mixed-seq traffic. Actions we discussed in the postmortem (copied here). Please claim items or propose owners + due dates.
Carla: Action list (from postmortem):
```
- A1: Produce repro harness and load test to validate eviction heuristics.
- A2: Implement adaptive eviction throttle and add canary.
- A3: Add detailed perf histograms + alert for KV eviction spike.
- A4: Update runbook and add RACI for failover -> fallback model.
- A5: Create quarterly owner rotation and oncall handoff checklist.
```

Dinesh: I'll pick up A1 (repro + load test). Creating RW ticket now, will link. ETA: 2 weeks (1773000000+14d).

jira-bot: Created ticket RW-5587: "repro-harness: cache-eviction-load-test" assigned to Dinesh. https://jira.redwood/RW-5587 (priority P2)

Alice: I'll take A3 (metrics/alerts). Can do an initial alert rule + dashboard by EOD next Weds. Link me to the prometheus dashboard template and I’ll reuse it. :thumbsup:

Ben: A2 (adaptive eviction) is more infra-heavy — happy to be R for design, but will need an implementation owner. Suggest pairing Ben (R) + Dinesh (C) for prototype. Proposed timeline: design 2w, canary 3w.

Dinesh: ok to C on A2, I can help with test harness integration. Assign RW-5590 for A2 design work.

jira-bot: Created ticket RW-5590: "adaptive-eviction-design" assigned to Ben. https://jira.redwood/RW-5590

Eva: For A4/A5 (runbook + rotation) I can own the doc and RACI. Proposed: publish updated runbook and rotation schedule by end of sprint (10 business days). I'll add a recurring calendar event and a short checklist in the runbook for handoffs.

Carla: Good. Can we make owners add DUE dates on the Jira tickets and link the postmortem doc? We need traceability for compliance. (reaction :eyes:)

Dinesh: RW-5587 updated with due date 1774400000 and linked postmortem doc. Also added a minimal reproduction script in the ticket attachments.

Alice: RW-5589 created for A3 alert work, assigned to Alice, due 1773600000. Dashboard PR in flight.

Ben: For visibility I propose a short weekly sync (15m) for 3 weeks during rollout. Will anyone else want to join? CC: @SRE & @Platform.

Eva: Yes please. Add to calendar as "pm-followup: cache eviction" recurring weekly for 3 weeks. I'll host the first one and do handoff notes.

Carla: Final RACI summary we agreed:
- A1: Dinesh (A), Ben (C)
- A2: Ben (A), Dinesh (C)
- A3: Alice (A)
- A4: Eva (A), Carla (C)
- A5: Eva (A)

Carla: I'll update the postmortem with these assignments and close out the follow-up checklist once tickets are in Done. If anyone needs to change ownership, please update the ticket and ping me. Thanks all. :heart:

Ben: Ack.

Dinesh: Ack, will post progress updates to this thread weekly.

Alice: Ack, will tag alerts PR for review tomorrow.
